 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The OKC Thunder will continue its 2026-27 NBA season with a home game against the Denver Nuggets at 8:30 p.m. CT Thursday.
 OKC began the season with a 116-104 road win over the San Antonio Spurs on Tuesday. This is the first game of the season for Denver, which was eliminated in the first round of the playoffs last season.
